expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: Beijing, Xi'an and Shanghai in nine nights is the route I give first timers. One imperial city, one ancient one, one modern one.
expert.tip: Book the bullet train seats on the left going south. You get the farmland and the Yellow River bridges rather than the service sheds.

summary: Ten days across the three cities most first time visitors want: imperial Beijing with the Great Wall and Universal Studios, the terracotta army at Xi'an, then the Bund, the Pearl Tower and Disneyland in Shanghai.
included: Included: 9 nights with daily breakfast across Beijing, Xi'an and Shanghai; private transfers; guided Beijing city tour; full day Great Wall at Mutianyu with the Summer Palace; Universal Studios Beijing tickets; Beijing to Xi'an bullet train; guided Xi'an sightseeing tour; half day guided Shanghai city tour; Oriental Pearl Tower tickets; Huangpu river cruise tickets; Shanghai Disneyland tickets.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Xi'an to Shanghai internal flight; China visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
